title: GSMT - Dan Holohan, Author: "The Lost Art of Steam Heating"
channel: The General Society of Mechanics and Tradesmen
summary: Dan Holohan, author of The Lost Art of Steam Heating, talks about the old steam heating systems he learned about from veteran tradesmen. He shares stories and practical lessons on how these systems work, including running steam at low temperatures.
why: HN recommends it as an informative talk on steam heating whose advice to respect old working systems carries over to software.

quote.text: When you see something that's old and it's been there for a long time and it's working, don't laugh at it.
